goals: Verify the functionality of administrative endpoints for creating, updating, and deleting student records
Verify correct HTTP status code responses for success and error scenarios in student management
activities: Authenticate user to obtain session cookie for administrative access
Create new student record and verify HTTP 201 success response
Attempt to create duplicate student record and verify HTTP 409 conflict response
Attempt to create student with missing data and verify HTTP 500 error response
Update existing student record and verify HTTP 200 success response
Delete existing student record and verify HTTP 302 redirect response
Attempt to delete non-existent student record and verify HTTP 500 error response
